response.justification: MOC-2009-0157 was raised at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop on 29 October 2009 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the key safeguard set is preserved.
